title: Puzzle3d Object Kind Vortices From Kit
description: Puzzle2d Node Kind Vortices From Kit
summary: Corrected terminology: puzzle 2d node kinds use `handles` templates (`NodeKindHandleTemplate`, `handleKind`); puzzle 3d object kinds use `vortices` (`ObjectKindVortexTemplate`, `vortexKind`). Baked nakagin 2d `meta.kindCatalogs.nodes[].handles` and 3d `meta.kindCatalogs.objects[].vortices` from metabolism kit connectors (one-off migrations, scripts removed). Remapped 3d `vortexKind` to vortex-catalog short ids via 2d handle names. Vitest: 2d/react 108, 3d/react 134.
